text: So what do the people get?
An online account with founder status, a three-D printed dome model keychain, a rear view mirror hanger, a window decal, a poster.
The middle tier adds a signed book that goes along with this codebase, the campaign, and the whole dome paradigm.
The high tier gets help idealizing and building digitally with me: game-plan forming for your own dome realization.
For future pad owners, dome collectors, and anybody gathering possibilities for later.
The campaign will set the actual tiers and delivery scope.
